agentGuide:
Confluence Cloud, base path /wiki (already in the address): v2 API under /api/v2, classic under /rest/api. Me: GET /rest/api/user/current. Spaces: GET /api/v2/spaces (id, key, name). Search: GET /rest/api/content/search?cql=&limit=10 (CQL: text ~ "words" AND space = DOCS; type = page AND lastmodified > now("-7d")). Pages of a space: GET /api/v2/spaces//pages?limit=25. One page with its content: GET /api/v2/pages/?body-format=storage (body.storage.value is XHTML; body-format=view for rendered HTML). Create: POST /api/v2/pages {"spaceId": "...", "status": "current", "title": "...", "parentId": "...", "body": {"representation": "storage", "value": "

...

"}}. Update: PUT /api/v2/pages/ with id, status, title, body and version {"number": } — read the page first for its version. Comments: GET /api/v2/pages//footer-comments. The credentials are set by Allkin.
